newsitem.title: UK: BFI down seven as Panamaxes weaken.
newsitem.headline: BFI down seven as Panamaxes weaken.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down seven points on Monday TO 1,267.
Brokers said the week opened quietly for Capers and Handy-sizes in most areas but there were a number of weaker fixtures reported for Panamaxes in both the Atlantic and Pacific.

Halla fixed Joyous Land for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan June 18/28 at a marginally weaker $21.20 no combo and Andre fixed 50,000 50 ft Paranagua to Lisbon for mid-June at $13.25, down 50 cents from last done.
Cargill were understood to have fixed Pasquale Della Gatta for 57,000 barley St.Lawrence to Saudi Red Sea at $19.75, down 75 cents from last done.

Weaker Panamax timecharter rates were reported in the East with modern vessels such as Paiute 70,200 dwt and Sumava 69,800 dwt booked for Australian or N.Pacific rounds at a lower level of $9,250 daily.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 10 points lower to unchanged at turnover was 61 lots. - - London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7771
